With train/test split

```{python}
TRAINING_SPLIT = False

TRAINING_SIZE = 0.8
RANDOM_SEED = 123
# Perform train/test split if necessary
if TRAINING_SPLIT:
    train_idx, test_idx = train_test_split(
        torch.arange(X_l_list[0].shape[0]),
        train_size = TRAINING_SIZE,
        random_state = RANDOM_SEED,
        shuffle = True
    )
    train_X_l_list = [X[train_idx, :] for X in X_l_list]
    test_X_l_list = [X[test_idx, :] for X in X_l_list]
    
    train_y = y[train_idx]
    test_y = y[test_idx]
else:
    train_idx = torch.arange(n)
    test_idx = torch.arange(n)
    
    train_X_l_list = X_l_list
    test_X_l_list = train_X_l_list
    
    train_y = y
    test_y = train_y

# Clean: remove 0 variance columns and standardize. Using Training data            
X_l_list_column_filters = [zero_variance_col_filter(X) for X in train_X_l_list]

train_X_l_list = [X[:, col_filter] for X, col_filter in zip(train_X_l_list, X_l_list_column_filters)]
test_X_l_list = [X[:, col_filter] for X, col_filter in zip(test_X_l_list, X_l_list_column_filters)]

clean_train_X_dict_list = [normalize_tensor_by_col(X) for X in train_X_l_list]
X_l_mean_list = [clean["means"] for clean in clean_train_X_dict_list]
X_l_sd_list = [clean["sds"] for clean in clean_train_X_dict_list]

clean_test_X_dict_list = [normalize_tensor_by_col(X, means, stds) 
                            for X, means, stds in 
                            zip(test_X_l_list, X_l_mean_list, X_l_sd_list)]

train_X_l_list_clean = [clean["data_clean"] for clean in clean_train_X_dict_list]
test_X_l_list_clean = [clean["data_clean"] for clean in clean_test_X_dict_list]

y_mean = torch.mean(train_y)
y_std = torch.std(train_y)

train_y_clean = (train_y - y_mean) / y_std
test_y_clean = (test_y - y_mean) / y_std
```

```{python}
train_subset = TensorDataset(torch.arange(train_X_l_list_clean[0].shape[0]), 
                                         *train_X_l_list_clean, 
                                         train_y_clean)
test_subset = TensorDataset(torch.arange(test_X_l_list_clean[0].shape[0]), 
                                         *test_X_l_list_clean, 
                                         test_y_clean)
```

With custom guide.
During training, the model and guide are used. During prediction, save the ParamStore global latent variables and include as prior values in the prediction model and prediction guide. The guide only includes `pyro.param` statements over the local latent variables and only updates these. Run SVI for a certain number of epochs until convergence. Then use 

```{python}
train_subset.__len__()
```

```{python}

pyro.clear_param_store()

MINIBATCH_SIZE = 32
NUM_EPOCHS = 500
MIN_EPOCHS = 50
initial_lr = 0.001
gamma = 0.001  # final learning rate will be gamma * initial_lr
lrd = gamma ** (1 / (NUM_EPOCHS * MINIBATCH_SIZE))
OPT = Adam({"lr": initial_lr})
# OPT = AdagradRMSProp({})
# OPT = Adam({"amsgrad": True}) #"lr": initial_lr)
# OPT = ClippedAdam({"lr": initial_lr, "lrd": lrd,, "betas": (0.8, 0.95)}) # (0.9, 0.999) (0.95, 0.999
LOSS = Trace_ELBO(num_particles = 2)

k_upper = int(k) + 10
k_l_upper = [int(k_l) + 10 for k_l in k_l_list.tolist()]

# hyperparam = 5.0
factor_model = SupMultiviewDecomp(
    k_upper,
    k_l_upper,
    ortho_penalty = 0.0,
    include_view_factors = True,
    dense = False
)

train_handler = ModelHandler("train", factor_model, opt = OPT, loss = LOSS)

t0 = time.time()
svi = train_handler.do_inference(
    train_dataset = train_subset,
    inference = "svi",
    tol = 0.5, # tolerance is epoch loss per datum
    variational_tol = 0.1,
    min_epochs = MIN_EPOCHS,
    epochs = NUM_EPOCHS,
    minibatch_flag = True,
    minibatch_size = MINIBATCH_SIZE,
    variational_diff_func = np.mean,
    verbose = True
    )

t1 = time.time()
run_minibatch = t1 - t0
print(f"Minibatch runtime: {run_minibatch / 60} mins, , {factor_model.total_epochs} epochs")
```

Using SVGD

```{python}
factor_model = SupMultiviewDecomp(
    int(k),
    k_l_list.int().tolist(),
    n,
    include_view_factors = True,
    dense = False
)

pyro.clear_param_store()

NUM_EPOCHS = 1000
initial_lr = 0.005 

gamma = 0.1  # final learning rate will be gamma * initial_lr
lrd = gamma ** (1 / (NUM_EPOCHS * MINIBATCH_SIZE))

OPT = Adam({"lr": initial_lr})
# OPT = ClippedAdam({"lr": initial_lr, "lrd": lrd})
kernel = RBFSteinKernel()

t0 = time.time()
svi, opt = do_inference(
    X_l_list_clean,
    y_clean,
    factor_model,
    kernel,
    opt = OPT,
    # elbo = LOSS,
    inference = "svgd",

    min_epochs = 10,

    minibatch_size = MINIBATCH_SIZE,
    verbose = True
    )

t1 = time.time()
run_minibatch = t1 - t0
print(f"Minibatch runtime: {run_minibatch / 60} mins, , {factor_model.total_epochs} epochs")
```

# Simulation replicates

```{python}
sim_data_path = "~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Projects/multiomic_integration/sim/data3/"

# Absolute paths to directories containing dataset replicates
dirs = [os.path.join(sim_data_path, dir) \
    for dir in os.listdir(os.path.expanduser(sim_data_path)) \
        if os.path.isdir(os.path.expanduser(os.path.join(sim_data_path, dir)))]

dirs[0:5]
```

```{python}
filename_dict = {os.path.basename(name): os.listdir(os.path.expanduser(name)) for name in dirs}
```

Parameters
```{python}
n_array = (50, 100, 500, 1000)
p_array = (50, 100, 1000)
snr_x_array = (2, 1, 0.5)
snr_y_array = (2, 1, 0.5)
reps = 1
loading_sparsity = 0

sim_grid = itertools.product(
    n_array,
    p_array,
    snr_x_array,
    snr_y_array,
    # range(reps),
    [loading_sparsity]
)
```

Load sim_data_path and filename_dict previously

```{python}
[x+1 for x in range(1)]
```

```{python}
MINIBATCH_SIZE = 32
NUM_EPOCHS = 1000
initial_lr = 0.01

gamma = 0.1  # final learning rate will be gamma * initial_lr
lrd = gamma ** (1 / (NUM_EPOCHS * MINIBATCH_SIZE))

file_dir_base = "n{}p{}_snr{}.{}_sparse{}" #/sim_data_ywithview_rep{}.rds"
file_name_base = "sim_data_ywithview_rep{}"

model_out_path = os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Projects/multiomic_integration/sim/results/integration/models")
model_out_filename_base = "run_autonormalguide_n{}p{}_snr{}.{}_sparse{}_rep{}"

metric_out_path = os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Projects/multiomic_integration/sim/results/integration/metrics")
metric_out_filename_base = "run_autonormalguide_n{}p{}_snr{}.{}_sparse{}_rep{}"

metric_list = []

for n, p, snr_x, snr_y, sparsity in sim_grid:
    pyro.clear_param_store()
    print("Loading:")
    print(file_dir_base.format(n, p, snr_x, snr_y, sparsity))
    # Load data
    # file_name_base.format(n, p, snr_x, snr_y, sparsity) #, rep)
    files_for_condition = load_and_process_rds_data_for_condition(
        file_dir_base.format(n, p, snr_x, snr_y, sparsity), # "n100p100_snr2.2_sparse0", 
        sim_data_path, # loaded above
        filename_dict, # loaded above
        reps) # how many reps to import

    for rep in range(reps):
        ##################
        # Setup replicate data
        print(file_name_base.format(rep))
        sim_data = files_for_condition.get(file_name_base.format(rep))
        
        k = int(sim_data.get("K"))
        X_l_list = sim_data.get("X_l")
        y = sim_data.get("y")
        k_l_list = sim_data.get("K_l").int().tolist()
        n = X_l_list[0].shape[0]
        p_l = int(sim_data.get("p_l")[0])

        # Clean
        clean_X_dict_list = list(map(normalize_tensor_by_col, X_l_list))
        # normalize_tensor_by_col(X)

        # X_clean = clean_X_dict.get("data_clean")
        # X_means = clean_X_dict.get("means")
        # X_stds = clean_X_dict.get("sds")
    
        X_l_list_clean = [clean["data_clean"] for clean in clean_X_dict_list]
        X_l_mean_list = [clean["means"] for clean in clean_X_dict_list]
        X_l_sd_list = [clean["sds"] for clean in clean_X_dict_list]

        y_mean = torch.mean(y)
        y_std = torch.sd(y)
        y_clean = (y - y_mean) / y_std

        ##################
        # Perform model inference
        factor_model = SupMultiviewDecomp(
            k,
            k_l_list,
            n,
            include_view_factors = True
        )

        def subsample_create_plates(X, batch_idx, y = None):
            return pyro.plate("obs", factor_model.n, subsample = batch_idx)
        guide = pyro.infer.autoguide.AutoNormal(
            factor_model, 
            create_plates = subsample_create_plates)

        # OPT = Adam({"lr": initial_lr})
        OPT = ClippedAdam({"lr": initial_lr, "lrd": lrd})
        LOSS = Trace_ELBO(num_particles = 1)

        t0 = time.time()
        svi, opt = do_inference(
            X_l_list_clean,
            y_clean,
            model = factor_model,
            guide = guide,
            opt = OPT,
            elbo = LOSS,
            tol = 0.5, # tolerance is on epoch loss per datum
            epochs = NUM_EPOCHS,
            minibatch_flag = True,
            minibatch_size = MINIBATCH_SIZE
            )
        t1 = time.time()
        run_minibatch = t1 - t0
        
        #################
        # Inference finished, save and evaluate
        # Save model parameters

        model_out_filename = os.path.join(
            model_out_path, 
            model_out_filename_base.format(n, p, snr_x, snr_y, sparsity, rep))
        print("Exporting:")
        print(model_out_filename)
        

        torch.save({
            "inference_time": run_minibatch,
            # "model_param_store": pyro.get_param_store(),
            "model_state_dict": pyro.get_param_store().get_state(),
            "optimizer_state": opt.get_state(),
            "loss_history": factor_model.loss_history
        }, model_out_filename + ".pth")

        pyro.get_param_store().save(model_out_filename + "_paramstore.pth") #os.path.join(model_out_path, model_out_filename + "_paramstore.pth"))
        
        #################
        # Evaluate model 
        EST_decomp = extract_est_decomp(L, True)

        EST_Struct_shared_l_list = list(map(calc_struct, \
            [EST_decomp.get("EST_Z")] * L, EST_decomp.get("EST_Lambda_l_list")))
        EST_Struct_view_l_list = list(map(calc_struct, \
            EST_decomp.get("EST_Phi_l_list"), EST_decomp.get("EST_Gamma_l_list")))

        SIM_decomp = extract_sim_decomp(sim_data_multiview_torch)

        SIM_Struct_shared_l_list = list(map(calc_struct, \
            [SIM_decomp.get("SIM_Z")]* L, SIM_decomp.get("SIM_Lambda_l_list")))
        SIM_Struct_view_l_list = list(map(calc_struct, \
            SIM_decomp.get("SIM_Phi_l_list"), SIM_decomp.get("SIM_Gamma_l_list")))

        EST_Struct_shared_l_list_rescaled = scale_est_struct(EST_Struct_shared_l_list, X_l_mean_list, X_l_sd_list)
        SIM_Struct_shared_l_list_rescaled = scale_sim_struct(SIM_Struct_shared_l_list, X_l_mean_list, X_l_sd_list)

        EST_Struct_view_l_list_rescaled = scale_est_struct(EST_Struct_view_l_list, X_l_mean_list, X_l_sd_list)
        SIM_Struct_view_l_list_rescaled = scale_sim_struct(SIM_Struct_view_l_list, X_l_mean_list, X_l_sd_list)

        shared_rse = [eval_rse(est, sim).detach().item() for est, sim in zip(EST_Struct_shared_l_list_rescaled, SIM_Struct_shared_l_list)]
        view_rse = [eval_rse(est, sim).detach().item() for est, sim in zip(EST_Struct_view_l_list_rescaled, SIM_Struct_view_l_list)]

        eval_metric_table = pd.melt(pd.DataFrame({
            "shared": shared_rse,
            "view_specific": view_rse
            }
            ).rename_axis('view').reset_index(),
            id_vars = ["view"],
            value_vars = ["shared", "view_specific"],
            var_name = "structure",
            value_name = "rse").\
            assign(n = n,
                p = p_l,
                snr_x = snr_x,
                snr_y = snr_y,
                runtime = run_minibatch
                )

        # Save evaluation
        metric_out_filename = os.path.join(
            metric_out_path, 
            metric_out_filename_base.format(n, p, snr_x, snr_y, sparsity, rep))
        print("Exporting metrics:")
        print(metric_out_filename)

        eval_metric_table.to_csv(metric_out_filename)
        metric_list.append(eval_metric_table)

```

# SupMultiviewShared

Multiview model with shared latent scores Z and view-specific loading matrices Lambda_l.
No view-specific factors. Outcome y ~ Z @ beta.

## Setup

```{python}
import importlib

sys.path.insert(1, "/Users/jonathanhori/multiomic_integration/python")

os.environ["R_HOME"] = "/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources"
```

```{python}
from data_utils import summarise_post_samples

# Training: posterior mean of Z_train @ beta (global model, no outcome noise)
train_post = train_handler.predict(
    data_package["train_X_l_list_clean"],
    300,
    [Sites.outcome_structure],
)
train_pred_mean = train_post[Sites.outcome_structure].mean(dim=0).squeeze()

# Test: posterior mean of Z_test @ beta (local model, no outcome noise)
test_post = test_handler.predict(
    data_package["test_X_l_list_clean"],
    300,
    [Sites.outcome_structure_pred],
)
test_pred_mean = test_post[Sites.outcome_structure_pred].mean(dim=0).squeeze()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))
for ax, pred, true, title in [
    (axes[0], train_pred_mean, data_package["train_y_clean"], "Train"),
    (axes[1], test_pred_mean,  data_package["test_y_clean"],  "Test"),
]:
    ax.scatter(pred.tolist(), true.tolist(), alpha=0.6)
    lim = max(abs(true).max(), abs(pred).max()).item() * 1.1
    ax.set_xlim(-lim, lim)
    ax.set_ylim(-lim, lim)
    ax.axline((0, 0), slope=1, color="black", ls="--")
    ax.set_xlabel("Predicted y")
    ax.set_ylabel("True y")
    ax.set_title(f"Outcome predictions — {title}")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Cross-validation for hyperparameter selection

```{python}
import itertools
importlib.reload(sys.modules["run_methods"])
from run_methods import run_cv_grid_shared
from data_utils import zero_variance_col_filter
```

```{python}
# Pre-filter each view using the full dataset to remove zero-variance columns.
# Normalisation is deferred to inside each fold so there is no cross-fold leakage.
X_l_raw    = sim_data["X_l"]
y_cv_raw   = sim_data["y"].squeeze()

cv_col_filters = [zero_variance_col_filter(X) for X in X_l_raw]
X_l_cv_raw     = [X[:, f] for X, f in zip(X_l_raw, cv_col_filters)]

print(f"CV data: {X_l_cv_raw[0].shape[0]} observations")
for l, X in enumerate(X_l_cv_raw):
    print(f"  View {l}: {X.shape[1]} features (after zero-var filter)")
```

```{python}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AdagradRMSProp hyperparameter grid
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
eta_cv_array       = [0.1, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0]
delta_cv_array     = [1e-16]
t_cv_array         = [0.1, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0]
particle_cv_array  = [2]
minibatch_cv_array = [32]
min_epoch_cv_array = [200]
max_epoch_cv_array = [500]

cv_train_grid_names = (
    "eta", "delta", "t",
    "num_particles", "minibatch_size", "min_epochs", "max_epochs",
)

cv_train_grid = list(itertools.product(
    eta_cv_array, delta_cv_array, t_cv_array,
    particle_cv_array, minibatch_cv_array, min_epoch_cv_array, max_epoch_cv_array,
))
print(f"{len(cv_train_grid)} hyperparameter configurations")
```

```{python}
cv_model_config = {"k": K_FIT, "dense_model": False}

N_CV_FOLDS             = 5
CV_SEED                = 42
N_CV_POSTERIOR_SAMPLES = 100
```

```{python}
def select_best_config(cv_results, grid_names, metric="outcome_mse", lower_is_better=True):
    """Return (best_config dict, per-config mean metric Series) from a CV results DataFrame."""
    agg      = cv_results.groupby("config_idx")[metric].mean()
    best_idx = int(agg.idxmin() if lower_is_better else agg.idxmax())
    best_row = cv_results[cv_results["config_idx"] == best_idx].iloc[0]

    best_config = {}
    for k in grid_names:
        v = best_row[k]
        if isinstance(v, np.integer):
            v = int(v)
        elif isinstance(v, np.floating):
            v = float(v)
        best_config[k] = v
    return best_config, agg
```

```{python}
# n_workers=1  -> sequential, safe everywhere
# n_workers=N_CV_FOLDS -> all folds in parallel via joblib/loky
N_CV_WORKERS = N_CV_FOLDS

cv_results_shared = run_cv_grid_shared(
    X_l_cv_raw, y_cv_raw,
    model_config=cv_model_config,
    train_grid=cv_train_grid,
    train_grid_names=cv_train_grid_names,
    n_folds=N_CV_FOLDS,
    seed=CV_SEED,
    n_posterior_samples=N_CV_POSTERIOR_SAMPLES,
    opt="adagrad",
    n_workers=N_CV_WORKERS,
)
```

```{python}
# Boxplot of outcome MSE for the top configs
top_n = 10
top_config_ids = cv_summary_shared.head(top_n).index.tolist()
top_cv = cv_results_shared[cv_results_shared["config_idx"].isin(top_config_ids)].copy()
top_cv["config_label"] = (
    "eta="   + top_cv["eta"].astype(str)
    + " t="  + top_cv["t"].astype(str)
    + " bs=" + top_cv["minibatch_size"].astype(str)
)
label_order = (
    top_cv.groupby("config_label")["outcome_mse"].mean()
    .sort_values().index.tolist()
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
sns.boxplot(data=top_cv, x="outcome_mse", y="config_label", order=label_order, ax=ax)
ax.set_title(f"CV outcome MSE — top {top_n} configs")
ax.set_xlabel("Outcome MSE (standardised y)")
ax.set_ylabel("")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
